Sam Bhagwat is the Co-founder and CEO of Mastra, the leading open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents (YC W25). Previously, he co-founded Gatsby, used by hundreds of thousands of developers, and is the author of Principles of Building AI Agents.

Sam Jarvinen is a Senior Solutions Engineer at GitHub with more than 15 years in technology and a career defined by one constant: supporting developers, in one shape or form. He's backed engineers across nearly every corner of software from mobile development to game studios, where he owned the Perforce service across Microsoft's game-development org. Along the way he's supported military-grade systems development in Europe and spent years deep in the Microsoft stack standing up GitHub Enterprise inside Microsoft and driving security and supply-chain response work. Today his focus is customer-facing: helping engineering teams and leaders adopt AI coding agents and DevSecOps. At WeAreDevelopers, he explores how autonomous pull requests can ship without surrendering control.

Sandeep is an engineering leader with 11+ years of experience in distributed systems, storage engines, infrastructure security and cloud-native platforms. Currently Principal Engineer at Salesforce, driving multi-cloud standards and strategy across AWS, GCP, and Alibaba Cloud.
Previously, I worked on planet-scale HBase deployments at Salesforce and delivered Spark optimizations at Snapchat that saved tens of millions in infrastructure costs.

I am the founding member of MultiCloudJ, Salesforce’s open-source Java SDK for multi-cloud development, and a contributor to Apache HBase, Apache Phoenix, Apache Spark, and GoCloud.dev. Passionate about building resilient, cloud-agnostic, and data-driven systems that create real-world impact.

Sandhya Subramani is a Sr. Developer Advocate with 8+ years of experience in Applied AI Research, specializing in Large Language Models and agentic AI systems. She has developed and deployed AI solutions at organizations including Amazon, Warner Bros, and Fidelity Investments. Her work centers on turning cutting edge research into practical applications, and she is passionate about helping developers build intelligent systems that solve complex problems at scale.

Sandon Jacobs is a Developer Advocate at Confluent, based in Raleigh, NC. Sandon has two decades of experience designing and building applications, primarily on the JVM. His data streaming journey began while building data pipelines for real-time bidding on mobile advertising exchanges—and Apache Kafka was the platform to meet that need. Later work in television media and the energy sector included Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, and provisioning Kafka infrastructure with various infrastructure as code frameworks.

Saurabh Sharma is the Chief Product Officer at You.com. Scott Likens serves as the Chief AI Engineer over Global and US teams and leads the AI Engineering and Emerging Technology R&D teams domestically, driving the firm’s strategy around AI, Blockchain, VR, Quantum Computing, and other disruptors. Scott Voigt has enjoyed helping early-stage software businesses grow since the mid 90s, when he helped launch and take public nFront—one of the world's first Internet banking service providers.

Serdar Bicer is an experienced software engineering leader with a passion for driving innovation and fostering high-performing teams. Sheilah is a software engineer–turned developer advocate focused on  AI infrastructure and inference engineering. She is passionate about helping developers understand the systems behind deploying AI applications, while continuously learning and exploring the rapidly evolving AI landscape herself.

Shir Meir Lador leads an Applied AI Engineering team at Google Cloud with the mission to accelerate the developer journey from code to secure AI workloads in production. speakers.bio: Shruti Tiwari leads AI product development at Dell Technologies, where she builds enterprise AI systems for global customer support operations at scale. She mentors AI founders at various accelerators and serves as Lead Mentor for mission -driven startups under GPAI/OECD program.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Meta, I thrive at the intersection of complex systems, web performance, and developer experience. My career is defined by a commitment to engineering excellence—from driving large-scale architectural transformations to leveraging emerging AI technologies to solve the industry's toughest challenges.

Currently, I contribute to the architecture of Meta's Ads Manager, the world's largest React application. My work centers on ensuring top-tier performance and reliability for this mission-critical platform, employing rigorous observability practices to minimize browser crashes and optimize user experience at scale.

My recent focus centers on "AI-assisted engineering." By building production-grade AI codemod pipelines, I have demonstrated how non-deterministic agents can be constrained to perform reliable, deterministic transformations—migrating over 3,000 components with a 99.6% success rate, significantly reducing technical debt while maintaining velocity for over 1,200 active developers.

With a background spanning engineering leadership at Groupon to infrastructure work at Meta, I specialize in re-architecting consumer-facing applications and fostering high-performance engineering cultures. Whether it's diagnosing complex performance bottlenecks or designing scalable AI-driven development workflows, I am driven by the goal of making engineering more efficient, reliable, and developer-friendly.

Shubho Sengupta has been working on Deep Learning for the past 10 years; first at Baidu Silicon Valley AI Lab and then at Meta’s Fundamental AI Research Lab. He is currently the CTO of Axiom Math, building a self-improving super intelligent reasoner starting with an AI mathematician
Sidarth Aurora

With more than 15 years in development and the experience of building and working on over 200 projects for startups and multinational companies Simon has worked professionally with almost every major modern framework. Siwei Shen is a seasoned engineering leader currently serving as Vice President of Engineering at Coinbase where he oversees technical infrastructure, AI implementation, and blockchain platforms.

Sofia Rest is a software engineer on Sentry's Agent Interfaces team, where she builds Seer, Sentry's AI debugging agent, and connects it to the tools, data, and context it needs to find and fix bugs. Hi, I’m a Sr. Machine Learning Engineer on ServiceNow’s internal AI Platform team, where I focus on building large-scale information retrieval systems and AI-powered experiences such as search, conversational assistants, and intelligent workflows. Stefan Lederer is the CEO and Co-Founder of the Emmy® award-winning video technology software solutions provider, Bitmovin – in a time where the video and television market is at an inflection point. He founded Bitmovin out of research and standardization around MPEG streaming format, co-creating the MPEG-DASH standard that accounts for more than 50% of the US internet traffic today and is used by Netflix, Youtube, Hulu, and others. Bitmovin is a YCombinator startup backed by Atomico (led by the founder of Skype), as well as industry leaders, like the former VP of Engineering at Netflix, former CTO of Cisco, founder of Unity3D, and others. 

Stefan has more than 25 research papers and 10 patents in the field of multimedia delivery and networks and was named to Forbes Austria’ 30 Under 30 List in 2017. He is a regular speaker at industry conferences and active participant in multimedia standardization and research.

Stefan graduated in computer science and business administration from the Alpen-Adria University Klagenfurt (Austria) and previously worked for McKinsey, IBM, and Dolby.

Steve Chen founded Code & Coffee, a volunteer-run nonprofit developer community with 80,000 members across 30 cities. The organization hosts more than 300 events a year on an annual operating budget under $6,000.

A former college dropout and coding bootcamp graduate who found nearly every job in his tech career through community, Steve builds meetups that are social by default. 

He received CMX’s Community Industry Award for Nonprofit Community Professional in 2026 for his work building communities around Belonging, Trust, and Safety.

Suman Natarajan is a Senior Principal and Enterprise Growth Investor at B Capital, based in the San Francisco Bay Area. She focuses on investing in high-growth technology companies, with experience across enterprise software and B2B/B2B2C businesses. Prior to her current role, she served as a Principal at B Capital and has held investment positions with companies including Zesty, Starburst, Cribl, and Snyk.

Sunil Murthy helps enterprises realize business value from Data and AI by bridging the gap between innovation and production-scale execution. As part of Forward Deployed Engineering, he focuses on helping organizations move generative and agentic AI initiatives beyond pilot exploration and into enterprise deployment.

As Field CTO for Data & AI at IBM, Sunil serves as a trusted technical advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and CDOs across strategic accounts in banking, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, transportation, and government. He is often brought in when AI strategy meets architectural reality, helping executive teams navigate the complex journey from vision to implementation. His work spans AI strategy engagements, executive architecture workshops, industry-specific solution design, and production deployments. Through these efforts, he demonstrates real-world agentic workflows and measurable business outcomes rather than simply product capabilities.

Sunil’s perspective is grounded in hands-on experience building and scaling technology businesses, not just advising them. Sunil has taken enterprise software products from concept to market, helping grow one product’s customer base fivefold within its first year. He has also led merger and acquisition due diligence efforts and built and managed teams across the United States and globally.

Sunil previously led IBM’s Data & AI Global Alliances, where he expanded the Global Systems Integrator ecosystem to 12 major firms, including Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, and Capgemini. Under his leadership, the alliance ecosystem generated more than $100 million in partner pipeline within 18 months.

Today, Sunil’s focus is on agentic AI architecture, AI development lifecycle management, composable enterprise data architectures, and helping organizations build AI platforms as long-term strategic foundations rather than point solutions.

I’m a Chief Developer Advisor at Microsoft, working with CxOs and engineering leaders in EMEA to shape strategy, modernize developer experience, and navigate the shift toward human–agent collaboration. My work sits at the intersection of engineering depth and executive clarity — helping organizations make confident decisions about platforms, AI adoption, and the future of how software gets built.

I’m an engineer first and always. Thirty years in the craft means I still think in systems, constraints, and trade‑offs, and that technical grounding is what makes me effective in the rooms I’m invited into. Whether I’m advising on architecture, developer experience, or organizational design, I bridge hands‑on engineering reality with strategic direction so teams can deliver better, faster, and with more joy.

Tamar Bercovici is a VP of Engineering at Box where she leads the Core Platform team in scaling the foundational platform for the Box Content Cloud. Tamar also runs the annual Box Hackathon and is a frequent invited speaker at leading technology conferences like Velocity, @Scale, and Grace Hopper. Tamar was named one of Forbes Top 50 Women in Tech 2018, and #1 on Okta and Business Insider's Tech Up and Comers list 2019. Prior to Box, Tamar was an early-stage employee at XMPie (now a Xerox company). Tamar holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the Technion Israel Institute of Technology.

Tara Hernandez has spent nearly thirty years evolving ways for companies to develop and ship software. She helped launch Mozilla.org and has been a firm proponent of open source ever since. She also thinks smart companies understand the business value of having a diverse employee base. Tara currently works at MongoDB, is a board member of a number of organizations focused on diversity in tech, and a trustee of the UC Santa Cruz Foundation.

Tejas Pravinbhai Patel is an IEEE Award-Winning Researcher, acclaimed Keynote Speaker, and Senior Software Engineer at Amazon, where he architects large-scale, distributed AI systems deployed in high-impact production environments worldwide. With a career spanning cloud-native platforms, backend infrastructure, and AI-driven systems, Tejas is recognized for his ability to bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and real-world engineering at scale.

As an active IEEE researcher, author, and peer reviewer, Tejas has earned recognition for his contributions to the fields of AI systems, distributed computing, and intelligent agent design. His award-winning research has been presented at leading IEEE conferences and journals, advancing the state of the art in AI reliability, scalability, and operational intelligence.

A sought-after keynote speaker at top-tier technology conferences, Tejas delivers compelling, insight-rich presentations that challenge conventional thinking and inspire engineers to build better, more trustworthy AI systems. His keynotes are known for combining deep technical depth with practical, actionable takeaways drawn from production experience at Amazon scale.

Tejas specializes in AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, LLM-powered applications, distributed systems reliability, and cloud-native AI deployment. He is passionate about making AI systems production-ready — moving beyond benchmark performance to operational excellence in real-world environments.

Whether speaking on stage or publishing groundbreaking research, Tejas brings a rare combination of industry expertise, academic rigor, and communication excellence that makes him one of the most impactful voices in AI and Cloud engineering today.

Thanos Baskous is the VP Engineering and Co-Founder of Cogent Security. Thanos brings decades of experience building and managing infrastructure in high-security environments. Prior to Cogent, he led Infrastructure at Coinbase and previously led Engineering at Blackstone and held senior positions at Twitter and TellApart.

Thariq Shihipar is a member of technical staff at Anthropic working on Claude Code, where he develops the tools and interaction patterns that allow AI agents to investigate problems, clarify uncertainty and verify their work. Before joining Anthropic, he co-founded the academic publishing platform PubPub and led One More Multiverse, a Y Combinator-backed collaborative gaming company.

Shihipar began building startups while studying computer engineering at the University of Toronto. He co-founded Chime, a web-notification startup acquired by HubSpot in 2013, and subsequently worked at HubSpot before pursuing graduate studies at the MIT Media Lab.

At MIT, he and Travis Rich created PubPub, an open-source scholarly publishing platform combining collaborative editing, discussion, annotations and multimedia. He also developed NewsClouds, a news-visualization project, and later built Edgeout.gg, a gaming analytics platform acquired by Blitz.

With Hisham Bedri and illustrator Sara Alfageeh, Shihipar co-founded One More Multiverse, which developed browser-based tools for playing tabletop role-playing games in illustrated digital worlds. After winding down the company, he joined Anthropic’s Claude Code team.

As the Technical Evangelist at Varnish Software, Thijs Feryn focuses on web performance, software scalability, and content delivery. He demonstrates content-driven and technical messaging through presentations, videos, books, blog posts, social media posts, podcasts, and other media.

Thijs is a published author and wrote Getting Started with Varnish Cache and Varnish 6 by Example. As a public speaker, he has a track record of over 370 presentations in 26 different countries, where he is often praised for his energetic and engaging presentation style.

As an evangelist, Thijs is also active in many open-source communities, most notably the Varnish and PHP community. He has contributed to various communities for over 15 years both technically and as an organizer and facilitator.

Prior to joining Varnish Software, Thijs Feryn spent 15 years in the web hosting industry, tackling web performance and scalability issues on a daily basis and evangelizing these topics.

Fascinated by software development since his childhood in Germany, Thomas Dohmke has built a career creating tools developers love. Based out of Seattle, Washington, Thomas is the CEO and co-founder of Entire, the world's next developer platform in the era of AI. Formerly, Thomas was Chief Executive Officer of GitHub, where he led the company’s growth to over 150 million developers and oversaw the rise of GitHub Copilot, the world’s most widely adopted AI developer tool. Thomas is a celebrated TED speaker and holds a PhD in mechanical engineering from the University of Glasgow, UK.

Thomas Neumayer is Co-Founder of ExtensityAI, an AI technology company building next-generation enterprise AI systems. ExtensityAI combines neural AI with structured reasoning and automation to help companies deploy reliable, explainable and scalable AI applications in real-world business environments. Thomas focuses on strategy, commercialization and translating advanced AI technology into products and use cases that create measurable business impact.

Thorsten Hans is a Senior Developer Advocate at Akamai, Docker Captain, and Wasm enthusiast. He thrives on pushing the limits of WebAssembly and Edge Computing to help developers build high-performance distributed systems. Thorsten shares his technical deep-dives via his blog and on global stages to shape the cloud’s future.

Tom Palczewski is a Tech Lead, Expert AI/ML Applied Scientist - Generative AI at SAP, where he works on Foundational Models for structured data and knowledge graphs. Previously, he was a Staff Machine Learning Engineer 2 and Staff Data Scientist at Samsung Research America, where he applied his knowledge and skills in generative AI, recommender systems, and data engineering to create novel solutions for Samsung's products and services.

He has over 10 years of experience in research and development of data-driven models at scale, spanning modeling on structured-data, graphs, development of custom computer vision, and natural language processing solutions.

He has worked and collaborated with prestigious institutions such as CERN, J-PARC, the University of Alabama, LBNL, and UC Berkeley. His book about production ready applied Deep Learning was well received (https://a.co/d/3pG9bLT). He is also an author of multiple publications (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=v5PUqKkAAAAJ&hl=en) and patents, a recipient of the Antarctica Service Medal. He is passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and making an impact on the world.

Tom holds a PhD in Physics from the National Centre for Nuclear Research and an Executive MBA from Quantic School of Business and Technology. In parallel to his studies in Physics, he has finished PhD studies in Economics at the Warsaw School of Economics (abd).
speakers.company_position: Tech Lead, Expert AI Scientist - Generative AI

speakers.bio: Tom lives in South Wales in the United Kingdom. He started using TYPO3 back in 2008 and has worked on projects as both an integrator and developer for various organisations in the public and private sectors. Tom's current role sees him delivering TYPO3 training courses and producing video content as part of the TYPO3 Knowledge Unit team, where he writes and produces educational videos for the TYPO3 project.

Tomislav Tipurić is a business and technology professional who connects technical expertise with business strategy to clarify new technologies and drive corporate innovation. As a Chief Technology Officer and Lead Hackathon Coach, he focuses on artificial intelligence, multi-cloud platforms, and modern software development practices. He has designed more than 20 custom learning hackathons and delivered over 500 hands-on educational experiences, including more than 150 sessions dedicated to machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions. Tomislav translates technical concepts into business strategies, delivering workshops and lectures to C-level executives on the business impact of AI in their industries. Additionally, he has experience in sales enablement and corporate training, serving as a program trainer to help enterprise partners market, sell, and adopt generative AI and cloud productivity tools, and delivering cloud sales enablement programs for global telecommunications firms. Tomislav is certified and authorized as an official trainer by Google and Microsoft.

Tommy Tran is a software engineer at Meta, where he leads work on automated capacity efficiency, building the AI-agent systems that keep Meta's large-scale AI infrastructure running efficiently.
He authored Meta's Engineering Blog publication on that work, which was covered by the technical press, and he has been profiled by international media, including a feature interview on the French technology program Monde Numérique.
Earlier, he built machine-learning systems for ads and monetization at Meta and for sales automation at Ramp.
He holds an MSc in Data Science from École Polytechnique (X) and HEC Paris, and is a selected speaker at leading AI and developer conferences.
His work spans applied generative AI and AI-agent systems, including their application to large-scale AI infrastructure.

Trevor Cox has spent 28 years in mergers and acquisitions across Silicon Valley and Seattle. He began his career as an attorney at Gray Cary Ware & Freidenrich, one of the original Silicon Valley law firms. He went on to lead Strategy and Transformation at Brocade, a Fortune 1000 data center company, served as Managing Director of EMEA at Infor, and held a senior M&A role at Wyse, both private equity-backed technology companies. He later founded Eisbach Group, a corporate development advisory firm, and DataCloud, an AI company serving process manufacturing, which he led to a successful exit. He now leads sell-side M&A engagements at i5 Growth Partners in artificial intelligence, data infrastructure, agentic technology, enterprise software, and AgTech/FoodTech for lower middle market companies. Trevor holds a JD and MBA from UC Berkeley and Columbia Business School.

Tushar Jain is the Chief Technology Officer at Docker, leading the work of building trust into the infrastructure agents run on. He is responsible for advancing systems that let AI agents operate autonomously without gaining uncontrolled access to sensitive data and services. His work applies Docker's experience with portable software to an emerging challenge: enforcing security boundaries around agents whose plans and permissions can change while they work.

Ussama is a Partner in PwC's Cloud, Engineering, Data & Analytics (CEDA) practice and the Anthropic Alliance CTO, with more than 25 years leading digital and technology transformations for Fortune 500 domestic and global clients across multiple industries. He leads PwC's Claude Native Modernization, Application Modernization, and Legacy Modernization offerings. His current work centers on taking AI-built software into production for enterprise clients and on the engineering practices that make it dependable at scale.
speakers.company_position: Principal, App Modernization & Development, Cloud Engineering & Data Analytics | Anthropic Alliance CTO

speakers.bio:
Vanessa Minik is a Senior Service Delivery Engineer at GitHub, where she helps organizations successfully adopt GitHub Copilot and AI-powered software development practices at scale. She works with enterprise engineering teams to develop AI adoption strategies, deliver technical enablement, and build practical guidance that helps organizations integrate AI into their software development lifecycle.
Vanessa specializes in AI collaboration, agentic workflows, and context engineering, helping teams move beyond using AI as a coding assistant to building sustainable, AI-native engineering practices. Her work focuses on enabling developers and organizations to effectively combine human expertise with AI while maintaining governance, code quality, and engineering best practices.
Drawing from real-world enterprise experience, Vanessa has designed and delivered workshops, technical trainings, and enablement programs for organizations adopting GitHub Copilot. She is passionate about making emerging AI capabilities approachable and actionable, giving teams practical strategies they can immediately apply to improve developer productivity and software delivery.

Varun is the Head of Partner Engineering at Meta, where he leads global engineering teams driving technical adoption and developer ecosystem strategy for open-source AI models, including Muse and Llama. With over 15 years of experience building high-scale consumer software, developer platforms, and strategic partnerships, Varun specializes in bringing complex technologies from 0-to-1 and scaling them globally.

Vasuki Uday Kiran Vudathala is a Staff Performance Engineer at ServiceNow specializing in large-scale performance engineering, observability, and reliability for cloud-native and generative AI platforms. With more than 15 years of experience across retail, e-commerce, airlines, and enterprise systems, he focuses on understanding how complex systems behave under sustained real-world conditions rather than isolated benchmark tests. His work includes peak workload engineering, long-session mobile performance validation on real devices, causal performance analysis, and performance-aware platform architecture. Vasuki is also the creator of the open-source JMeter Insights Pro project, an AI-powered performance analysis plugin for Apache JMeter, and has written technical articles for platforms including InfoQ, SD Times, HackerNoon, and Medium.

Victor is the creator of Nx, the agentic monorepo platforms, and Polygraph, the meta-harness for max agent autonomy. 

Victor has spent 20+ years developing high-performance frameworks and build tools for large-scale applications.

Vikas Mathur leads product and engineering for MariaDB. Vikas brings to the role his passion for delivering value in products by focusing on customer needs, as well as leveraging best practices in AI/Gen-AI, data platforms and enterprise readiness.

Vikas is a seasoned executive with 25+ years of enterprise growth experience in product management, R&D, GTM strategy and business development. Previously, he was at OpenText/MicroFocus where he was the Vice President of Product and Engineering for their IT Operations Management business with ~$550M in revenue, and led a global engineering team with hubs in India, China, Romania, Germany and the US. Prior to OpenText, Vikas was SVP of Products at Actian, a PE-backed database company with transactional, embedded, object, and columnar database products including Ingres. Prior to Actian, Vikas held various leadership and individual contributor roles in Strategy, GTM, and R&D at HP, A.T. Kearney, Sun Microsystems, and Apple.

Vikas graduated with an MBA from Haas School of Business, University of California, Berkeley. He also holds a M.S. in Computer Engineering from University of Kentucky, Lexington, and a B.E. in Electronics Engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. Vikas lives in Sunnyvale, CA with his wife and two daughters and enjoys playing tennis and hiking on trails around the Bay Area.

Viktor Gamov is a Principal Developer Advocate at Confluent, founded by the original creators of Apache Kafka®. With a rich background in implementing and advocating for distributed systems and cloud-native architectures, Viktor excels in open-source technologies. He is passionate about assisting architects, developers, and operators in crafting systems that are not only low in latency and scalable but also highly available.
As a Java Champion and an esteemed speaker, Viktor is known for his insightful presentations at top industry events like JavaOne, Devoxx, Kafka Summit, and QCon. His expertise spans distributed systems, real-time data streaming, JVM, and DevOps.
Viktor has co-authored "Enterprise Web Development" from O'Reilly and "Apache Kafka® in Action" from Manning. 
Follow Viktor on X—@gamussa to stay updated with his latest thoughts on technology, his gym and food adventures, and insights into open-source and developer advocacy.

Viktoria Semaan is a Principal AI Evangelist at Databricks with 15+ years of experience across AI, data engineering, cloud architecture, and technology strategy. She focuses on helping developers and enterprises turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, production-ready systems, with work spanning AI agents, multi-model architectures, governance, evaluation, and modern AI tooling.

Prior to Databricks, Viktoria worked at AWS, where she partnered with strategic ISVs to architect and bring cloud solutions to market. She holds an MBA from UCLA Anderson and completed an entrepreneurship program at HEC Paris.
Viktoria is a member of the Forbes Technology Council, a LinkedIn Top Voice in AI, and a frequent speaker at developer conferences worldwide. She shares technical education with an audience of 650,000+ professionals across social platforms and is ranked among the leading female technology creators globally.

Vince Hinojosa is a Principal Solution Architect at Sonatype, where he leads technical strategy (pre-sales) for software supply chain security across 22+ countries in Latin America and the U.S. West. He's built the networks and written the software he now helps customers secure, drawing on eight years in enterprise AppSec and DevSecOps. Bilingual (English, Spanish), based in Austin, Texas

Vinicius Senger is a technologist, builder, entrepreneur, and Senior Technical Evangelist for Startups at AWS. He began coding at eight years old and has spent more than three decades turning emerging technologies into products, companies, communities, and unconventional machines.

He is the founder of Globalcode and The Developers Conference, a Java Champion, and a two-time Duke’s Choice Award winner. His work spans AI agents, serverless computing, Java, IoT, robotics, physical computing, and new human-computer interfaces. At AWS, Vinicius works with startups, founders, and communities to help ambitious ideas move from prototype to production—and to explore what becomes possible when AI moves beyond the screen.

Vishwak Thatikonda is a Lead Software Engineer and Founding Architect specializing in high-resilience, mission-critical systems. Known for building complex platforms from the ground up, his work ranges from engineering the ground systems for the NASA Perseverance Rover (Mastcam-Z) to architecting the "Product Data Brain" for 38,000 Starbucks stores—a foundational cornerstone for their next-generation global POS system.
A technical pioneer in both the startup and enterprise worlds, Vishwak served as the inaugural architect for an MIT GeoAI spinout (AirWorks), where he scaled the platform from $0 to a multi-million dollar venture fundraise. He has led industry-first banking initiatives for 18 million users at Credit Sesame and directed blockchain-logistics pilots for UPS. A former ACM Chairperson, Vishwak bridges the gap between deep-tech research and large-scale production reality. His latest open-source project, LambdaForge, empowers engineers to run professional-grade financial automation with near-zero operational overhead.

Viswanathan Ranganathan is a Senior Engineer at Netflix on the Delivery Engineering team, which powers service deployments across the entire platform. He currently focuses on building features that improve deployment safety and confidence in Netflix’s infrastructure. Previously, Viswanathan worked as a Senior Backend Engineer at Atlassian and a Technical Lead at Twilio, where he designed and built scalable systems capable of handling billions of messages per day. He is also passionate about distributed systems and cloud-native technologies, and enjoys experimenting with and contributing to open source projects.

Vivek Pandit is a Frontier AI Lead at Turing, building RL environments and post training capabilities for AI systems. He was previously a Principal Engineer at Cadence, building agentic AI platforms to accelerate semiconductor design workflows. He was the Founding ML Engineer at Chipstack (acquired by Cadence) where he led evaluation strategies and product development for AI driven chip design verification used by leading chip design companies. He was an Applied Scientist at Microsoft for 4+ years, building evaluations of large scale LLM powered systems like Copilot and reinforcement learning systems for manufacturing applications. His expertise includes agentic AI, LLM evaluation, reinforcement learning, and benchmarking production AI systems.

Vivian Hu is a Product Manager at Second State and a columnist at InfoQ. She is a founding member of the WasmEdge project. She organizes Rust and WebAssembly community events in Asia.

She focuses on building practical AI systems, with recent work centered on multi-agent architectures and developer tools that enable teams to run autonomous “AI employees”.

Vlad Luzin is the CTO and Co-Founder of BAND. Previously, Vlad served as VP, AI & Cloud Platform at Verint and VP, Product & Engineering at Lynceus, and earlier held senior roles at CME Group (post-NEX acquisition), where he helped run high-throughput trading platforms handling hundreds of billions of dollars in daily volume. Earlier in his career, he led distributed and fault-tolerant systems research at Israel’s Directorate of Defense R&D and spearheaded multi-agent AI initiatives at Samsung Telecom Research.

With 10+ years in engineering management, Vojta has been leading platform teams focusing on data, analytics & AI as an engineering directors at Mews, followed by leading data platform in largest Czech retail bank and finally moving to his latest challenge as a Head of Data at Apify.
Walden Yan

Wayne Liu is Chief Growth Officer and President of the Americas at Perfect Corp. An industry leader with over 15 years of experience, Liu has built the groundwork for Perfect by recruiting key talent, and establishing partnerships with beauty brands and retailers such as L’Oréal, Estee Lauder, Target, and other highly influential organizations. 

Prior to joining Perfect Corp., Liu was responsible for key partner development, sales strategy and business growth at Perfect’s parent company, CyberLink. While there, he grew several multi-million dollar global accounts and managed heavy weight industrial partners such as Lenovo, Intel, Qualcomm, Time Warner., Comcast, and DirecTV. 

Liu has worked in various engineering and marketing management positions at Intel, Broadcom and NVIDIA before joining Cyberlink.

Liu graduated from National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan in June 1992 with a Bachelor of Science degree. He completed his Masters of Science degree from Case Western Reserve University in June 1994. He then continued pursuing advanced studies by attending the Electrical Engineering Ph.D. program at the University of Southern California and later his Doctor of Education in Organization Change and Leadership. He also earned his MBA Degree in Finance from Santa Clara University in June 2011.

Wei Hu is the Senior Vice President of Research and Development at Oracle. He leads the development of mission-critical database capabilities as well as Blockchain, Kubernetes, Microservices, and Globally Distributed Databases.
 
Mr. Hu has B.S. and M.S. degrees from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). He has been with Oracle since 1998, holds more than 50 patents, and is the author and co-author of several books and papers.

Will Bryk is the Co-Founder and CEO of Exa, an applied AI research lab organizing human knowledge, starting with the web. Exa’s full-stack web search engine built from the ground up
for AI agents. A Harvard graduate in Computer Science and Physics and former software engineer at Cresta, Will co-founded Exa in 2021 on a thesis that was contrarian at the time: AI
agents would one day search the web more than humans. That future has arrived, and Exa built the infrastructure for it, operating its own index, ranking algorithms, and vector database rather than wrapping existing search APIs. Today, thousands of companies, including Cursor, Cognition, Notion, Vercel, and HubSpot, rely on Exa to power retrieval for AI applications, with custom indexes spanning 1B+ people, 50M+ companies, and 100M+ research papers. In May 2026, Exa raised a $250M Series C led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $2.2 billion valuation, joining earlier backers Benchmark and Y Combinator. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Zurich and
Singapore.

After studying Technical Physics and Business Administration, Wolfgang Platz began his professional journey as a software developer. While working on Austria’s largest IT insurance project, he quickly recognized the vital role of software testing. This insight led him to pioneer a new, no-code approach to test automation, empowering business users to take part in the testing process. 

In 2007, he founded Tricentis, which went on to become Austria’s first unicorn, boasting over 1,000 employees, $450 million in revenue, and a valuation of $4.5 billion.

Today, Wolfgang mentors emerging companies, helping them navigate the complexities of the business world. One of his greatest rewards is seeing those he has guided grow into leadership positions.

He remains at the forefront of modern technology, having delivered keynotes on cutting-edge topics such as blockchain, virtual reality, and artificial intelligence.

As managing director for SAP Labs U.S., Yaad oversees the strategy and operations for SAP’s 
largest development hub, with more than 5,000 employees across 11 locations. He champions 
employee engagement, fosters strong ecosystem partnerships, and ensures smooth operations 
and communication. He also leads location strategy for the largest concentration of SAP’s cloud 
development talent in the U.S.
Beyond his U.S. focus, Yaad leads the global Research & Innovation team that spearheads 
research, explores new and emerging technologies, and matures them for enterprise-ready use 
in the SAP application and platform portfolio.
Prior to his current roles, he steered SAP’s Technology & Innovation strategy, shaping the 
company’s technological direction. Since joining SAP in 2005, Yaad has held various leadership 
positions in development and product management across various product groups.
He has a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering and an MBA from Tel Aviv University
speakers.company_name: SAP Labs US & SAP Research & Innovation

speakers.bio: Yaron Schneider is Co-Founder and CTO of Diagrid and a co-creator of two CNCF graduated projects, Dapr and KEDA. He is a longtime open-source maintainer and Chair of the Workflows Working Group at the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF). Yaron focuses on building open, cloud-native infrastructure for reliable and secure AI agents and distributed applications.

Yoav Gal was a Product Lead at monday.com, where he leads the External Agents (BYOA) product domain, defining how third-party AI agents connect to and work inside monday. He has years of experience across enterprise and startups, B2B and B2C, spanning data science to product management, a path that shapes how he treats agent identity as the central design problem for AI at work.

Yuval Dvir has operated through two of the largest technology shifts of the modern era from the inside - Microsoft's digital transformation, and the AI transformation that Google, DeepMind, and SandboxAQ are leading. This makes him a rare translator between the old world and the new.
Across twenty years he has turned frontier science into real-world applications at Skype, Microsoft, Google, DeepMind, and now SandboxAQ, the Alphabet spinoff. At Google he built and led the global partner ecosystem behind Gemini and Workspace, cementing Google's distribution advantage and launching Gemini's first-ever global partnerships. He worked with DeepMind and Google Brain on moving science from research to revenue, through partnerships ranging from AI pathology to the connectomics project mapping the neural network of the fruit fly brain.
As a founding member of SandboxAQ, he drove the company’s first commercial engagements. He was also behind one of the largest pharma drug discovery deals in partnership with Google Cloud and the DeepMind co-scientist team. He holds an MSc in Applied Neuroscience from King’s College London and an MBA from INSEAD. He is the author of AI-Political (September 2026), which argues that AI is most powerful when it remains apolitical - innately unbiased and truth-seeking, the guardrail humans are not wired to be.
